local ft={
	projector = function(src, x, y, type, dam, state)
		state = initState(state)
		useImplicitCrit(src, state)
		local dur = 3
		local perc = 50
		if _G.type(dam) == "table" then dam, dur, perc = dam.dam, dam.dur, (dam.initial or perc) end
		local init_dam = dam * perc / 100
		if init_dam > 0 then DamageType:get(DamageType.FIRE).projector(src, x, y, DamageType.FIRE, init_dam, state) end
		local target = game.level.map(x, y, Map.ACTOR)
		if target then
			-- Set on fire!
			dam = dam - init_dam
			target:setEffect(target.EFF_BURNING, dur, {src=src, power=dam / dur, no_ct_effect=true})
		end
		return init_dam
	end,
}
initState=function()return {}end;useImplicitCrit=function()end;Map={ACTOR=1}
local immediate=0;DamageType={FIRE=1,PHYSICAL=2,MIND=3,get=function()return {projector=function(_,_,_,_,dam)immediate=dam end}end}
local target={EFF_BURNING=1,setEffect=function(self,id,dur,p)self.dur=dur;self.power=p.power end};game={level={map=function()return target end}}
for _,dam in ipairs({60,100,240})do ft.projector({},0,0,0,dam);assert(immediate==dam/2 and target.dur==3 and math.abs(target.power*3-dam/2)<1e-9)end
local rp={
	callbackOnTalentPost = function(self, t, ab, ret)
		if ab.type[1]:find("^steamtech/") and self.exoskeleton_absorb and ab.steam then
			local maxDamage = t.getMaxDamage(self, t)		
			local heal = util.getval(ab.steam, self, t) * t.getSteamHeal(self,t)/100
			self.exoskeleton_absorb = math.min((self.exoskeleton_absorb or 0) + heal, maxDamage)
		return true
		else return end
	end,
}
util={getval=function(v)return v end}
for _,kind in ipairs({'steamtech/gadgets','spell/other'})do for _,cost in ipairs({0,10,20})do
 local a={exoskeleton_absorb=50};local t={getMaxDamage=function()return 100 end,getSteamHeal=function()return 200 end};rp.callbackOnTalentPost(a,t,{type={kind},steam=cost},true);assert(a.exoskeleton_absorb==(kind=='steamtech/gadgets' and math.min(100,50+cost*2) or 50))
end end
local mt={
	callbackOnTakeDamage = function(self, t, src, x, y, type, dam, state)
		if not self:isTalentActive(self.T_FURNACE) then return end
		if type == DamageType.PHYSICAL or type == DamageType.MIND then return end
		
		local mp = self:hasEffect(self.EFF_FURNACE_MOLTEN_POINT)
		local reduction = 1
		if mp then reduction = 0.75 ^ mp.stacks end
		reduction = t.getResist(self, t) * reduction

		if mp and mp.stacks >= 10 and self:isTalentActive(self.T_MELTING_POINT) and self:getSteam() > 15 then
			self:callTalent(self.T_MELTING_POINT, "cleanActor")
			if not self.turn_procs.molten_furnace_trigger_vent then
				self.turn_procs.molten_furnace_trigger_vent = true
				self:forceUseTalent(self.T_FURNACE_VENT, {ignore_energy=true, force_target={x=src.x, y=src.y}})
			end
			self:removeEffect(self.EFF_FURNACE_MOLTEN_POINT, true, true)
		end

		if not self.turn_procs.molten_metal then self:setEffect(self.EFF_FURNACE_MOLTEN_POINT, 1, {}) end
		self.turn_procs.molten_metal = true

		return {dam=math.max(0, dam - reduction)}
	end,
}
for _,stacks in ipairs({9,10})do for _,steam in ipairs({14,15,16})do for _,dtype in ipairs({1,2,3})do
 local actor={T_FURNACE=1,T_MELTING_POINT=2,T_FURNACE_VENT=3,EFF_FURNACE_MOLTEN_POINT=1,turn_procs={},isTalentActive=function()return true end,hasEffect=function()return {stacks=stacks}end,getSteam=function()return steam end,callTalent=function(self)self.cleaned=true end,forceUseTalent=function(self)self.vented=true end,removeEffect=function(self)self.removed=true end,setEffect=function(self)self.added=true end};mt.callbackOnTakeDamage(actor,{getResist=function()return 10 end},{x=1,y=1},0,0,dtype,100,{})
 assert((actor.cleaned==true)==(stacks==10 and steam>15 and dtype==1))
end end end
print('PASS FIREBURN 3 magnitudes with exact 50/50 split; Exoskeleton 6 category/cost cases; Melting Point 18 stack/steam/type boundary cases')
